name: Vires
source: A silent warrior living in a "Tribe" within the Tower comprising exclusively of females. She dual-wields a longsword and shortsword with finesse and is the most skilled of the tribe's warriors. A person of few words who won't speak unless necessary, she's surprisingly passionate and proactive. She believes Strength is everything, so she pays respect to the strong and looks down on the weak. In her search for strong males (as her tribe requires strong seed to procreate), her eye is set on Velt the protagonist.
